items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: I used to go to the Pelican... And Satchel Paige was down many times.

ctx.x: I never have known. I know they had a team at one time called the Black Pelicans.

Well, that's why they named it. The Black Pelicans only called the Pelicans. Did you ever play with them? I never played. I was a boy. I was about eight, nine, eight or ten years old, possibly. You saw the Black Pelicans? Yes. I used to go to the Pelican, there's many catches, and sometimes the names come back to me. And Satchel Paige was down many times. And the team from Chicago, the Chicago Giants, used to take the players from the Orleans. They had one name. Jumbo Jackson was a great player baseman. And Hot…
And who else? You never saw Shooters Joe Jackson.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Satch and I used to, uh, pal around together.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's like, you know, who knows how old Satchel Paige is. Right. You know, I mean, could you guess?

Well, you make a guess. Uh, Satch and I used to, uh, pal around together. Uh, one time in Dallas, he felt like riding. He used to like to ride and he plays a guitar. He sat on the back of the car and ride. We never discuss Edge. I don't know why. But I do know this, that he's, he's older than me. And I was 64 years old in August. So I'm not gonna question Satchel's age. He's a little older than you. Yeah, if he says he's 29, that's his business, you know. Yeah.
No, I think he came out, I saw him on This Is Your Life, and he came out with his age.
